release_boundary_dispositions.disposition: China benchmark lending cuts occurred October21 after that day's00UTC but before October22 cutoff; actual25bps is supported by own-date CNBC headline, distinct from the prior pending preview.
October21 first swap-facility operations are completed by the October22 cutoff; no invented execution amounts or economy-wide credit acceleration claimed.
Economist's proposed future debt stimulus remains an economist suggestion, not enacted official spending.
Japan union5% target remains a negotiating objective, not settled wage growth.
Alphabet and Tesla own-date headlines explicitly establish pending earnings. No actual results or invented dates asserted.
France2.8%GDP deficit by2029 remains stated long-term objective, not achieved consolidation.
KNF proceeding is not final sanction; bank CHF strategy is not completed legal resolution; OrlenEUR2bn credit agreement is financing, not equity inflow/profit.
US election remains pending. Trading/donations and concentrated prediction-market bets are attributed individual actions, without representative consensus or election outcome.
